# 16. 3Sum Closest

## Solution 1 (O(n^2))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def threeSumClosest(self, nums, target):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :type target: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        nums.sort()
        n = len(nums)
        ans, diff = None, float("inf")
        for i in range(n - 2):
            p1, p2 = i + 1, n - 1
            while p1 < p2:
                t = nums[p1] + nums[p2] + nums[i]
                if t == target:
                    return target
                if abs(target - t) < diff:
                    diff = abs(target - t)
                    ans = t
                if t < target:
                    p1 += 1
                else:
                    p2 -= 1
        return ans
```
